observations.player_action: Use the inventory book icon, a supported quest-book item or a configured keybinding, then select a chapter.
observations.outcome: Authored quests show their description, tasks and rewards; a pack without quest definitions has an empty book.

observations.player_action: Match a proposed goal to the 1.20.1 task registry.
observations.outcome: TaskTypes registers item, custom, XP, dimension, stat, kill, location, checkmark, advancement, observation, biome, structure, gamestage and fluid tasks. Platform/addon tasks require their own installed registration evidence.

observations.title: Distinguish possession, crafting and submission
observations.player_action: Inspect an item task before collecting or crafting its target.
observations.outcome: ItemTask separates inventory checks from only_from_crafting progress, consuming submission and task_screen_only insertion; NBT and weak-NBT matching alter acceptable stacks. Owning an item cannot prove its use.
